brief: Sends HTTP requests for a reactive engine, asynchronously through a reactor when it has one and blocking otherwise.
detail: Get_, Post, Put_ and Delete take the address, the body where there is one, and a function for success and one for failure. With a reactor set by SetReactor, http and https requests are submitted as jobs and return a job number at once; the run loop calls DrainPending, which delivers each finished job to its callback, a 2xx status to onSuccess with the body and anything else to onError. Without a reactor, or for another kind of address, each verb runs a blocking stzHttpTask and returns it. None of the four verbs was run for this reference because they reach the network; the example uses what makes no request.
receiver:
oEngine = new stzReactive()
o1 = new stzReactiveHttp(oEngine)
